about: Made by tests/Feature/ScaleScorePackageCasesTest.php of the platform from its own cases (tests/fixtures/scale-score/cases.json, SPECS §75.6) — do not edit; UPDATE_PACKAGE_FIXTURES=1 writes it again. Per case: the API codebook of the matrix rows, one response as stored (a row a condition hides is empty), the items, min_items (null: the default, every item) and the score the platform gives (null: none).

cases.name: a reverse-scored row counts mirrored (1-4: 5 - answer)
one row missing, every row asked for: no value
one row missing, three asked for: the mean of the three
the missing row is the reverse-scored one: it does not count as the top of the scale (psych-66)
and with every row asked for, no value
UCLA-like 1-7, every row: b reversed as 8 - 6
an answer without a number (dk) does not count, and is not part of the scale
dk with every row asked for: no value
a reverse-scored row without a number scale cannot be mirrored: unanswered
a number on a reverse-scored row whose columns have one number only: nothing to mirror, the row is left out
only that row answered: it does not count, so nothing is answered and there is no value (not its unmirrored 1)
a minimum above the number of rows means every row
a row shown by its condition counts (reversed: 5 - 4)
a row hidden after it was answered counts as unanswered: with every row asked for, no value
the hidden row left out of the mean of the rest
